fields.description: Lillia is a gated townhouse neighbourhood at The Valley, with three- and four-bedroom homes overlooking landscaped surroundings. The development connects residential streets with outdoor recreation and the wider community’s parks, beach-style leisure area and Town Centre. Its two architectural treatments offer different facade styles within the same family-focused setting.

overview: Jade uses a softer combination of curves and straight lines, while Pearl takes a more angular approach. The brochure’s neighbourhood plan includes shaded play areas, a splash pad, informal lawns and a multiuse court. Shared amenities are distributed across Lillia and The Valley, so the distance from a particular home matters when comparing plots.
research.locationNote: Lillia is in The Valley along Dubai–Al Ain Road. Emaar highlights road access to Dubai’s major destinations. Published travel times are promotional estimates; assess the selected home’s route and peak-hour commute directly.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays AED 2m. The March 2024 launch sheet lists three bedrooms from AED 2m and four from AED 2.7m. Property Finder’s current-listing headline is higher than its launch figures. Confirm the asking price and availability of an individual home.
research.paymentNote: The historical schedule is 10% booking, 80% during construction and 10% on completion. Later instalments include two 15% payments. This is the launch plan; a resale purchase may have a different amount payable immediately.
research.handoverNote: The launch sheet estimates January 2027, also shown in Property Finder’s main timeline. Its FAQ says March 2027, while Mitchells reports June 2028 via PropSearch. A revised developer completion notice was not found; confirm the current contractual date.

facts.label: Launch mix
facts.value: 406 homes: 278 with three bedrooms and 128 with four. These are historical development totals, not available inventory.

facts.label: Average launch plots
facts.value: The fact sheet lists 1,485 sq ft for three bedrooms and 2,838 sq ft for four. Plot size is separate from the floor-plan totals.

facts.label: Everyday layout
facts.value: Plans show two levels, two-car parking, a maid’s room, laundry space, terraces and balconies. Four-bedroom designs place a guest bedroom downstairs; three-bedroom designs put all principal bedrooms upstairs.

facts.label: Block configuration
facts.value: Four-, six- and eight-home blocks produce small size variations within each design. Use the selected townhouse’s block and unit reference when checking its plan.

facts.label: Outdoor setting
facts.value: The brochure proposes landscaped leisure routes and spaces for play, fitness and community gatherings. Final delivery, access arrangements and operating charges require confirmation.

unresolved: Completion references conflict, including a later June 2028 broker report. The January 2027 figure remains explicitly a launch estimate, not confirmation of current delivery status.
Some portals show only one size per design. The table uses the fuller Emaar-branded plan ranges; dimensions and final saleable areas remain subject to the signed unit plan.
The plan pack and launch fact/payment sheet are broker-hosted copies. Obtain the latest developer-issued versions before relying on specifications or instalments.
Current inventory, outstanding payments, service charges and final handover condition need written confirmation. Site photographs remain illustrative.
